description: Change passcode, expiry, downloads, viewer mode, email gate, view limit, page range, slug

file.description: A file UUID, a short link id, or a share URL.

settings.description: The API's FileSettings object, passed through: viewerMode (standard|scroll|flipbook|swipe|magazine), password (empty string clears), allowDownload, requireEmail, notifyOnView, deleteAt (date-time), neverExpire, viewLimit (0 clears), gateDomains, gateFields, gateHeading, slug, watermark, pageRange. Omitted fields keep their value.
